b: Netflix’s The Beast in Me was billed as a one-and-done limited series, but the streamer recently announced that its Emmy-winning thriller would be returning for another round. Riley Keough and Lorelei Olivia Mote have joined the cast as series regulars, with Aaron Paul, Taip Ceman, and Matthew James Thomas set for recurring roles.

According to Deadline, Keough will play a rising filmmaker and mother, with Mote—who previously played a younger version of Keough’s character in Daisy Jones & the Six—as her 13-year-old daughter, an aspiring actress. Details on Paul’s character are being kept under wraps.

The newcomers join Claire Danes, who returns as novelist Aggie Wiggs, as well as John Goodman and Lili Taylor. Howard Gordon is back as showrunner, this time alongside Daniel Pearle, on the series created by Gabe Rotter. Whether Matthew Rhys’s Nile Jarvis, the neighbor at the dark center of the first season, will return hasn’t been confirmed.
No premiere date has been announced, but watch this spot.
